extracted.name: Cuban Mojito
extracted.description: This Cuban mojito blends sugar, fresh lime juice, mint sprigs, rum, and club soda for a sweet, citrusy refreshing drink perfect on a hot summer day.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups crushed ice, or as needed
instruction_lines: Place 1 teaspoon sugar each into two 12-ounce glasses. Squeeze juice from a lime wedge into each glass and drop in the wedge. Place 2 mint sprigs into each glass. Use a spoon or muddler to mash lime mixture together in the bottom of the glasses.
Fill each glass about half full with crushed ice. Pour 1/4 cup rum into each glass. Fill the glasses with club soda, stir, and garnish with remaining lime wedges.
